newsitem.title: UK: Laporte extends gains on positive comment.
newsitem.headline: Laporte extends gains on positive comment.

text.p: Shares in Laporte Plc extended their early gains on Thursday amid positive analyst comment following the speciality chemical firm's year-end review, traders said.
By 1230 GMT the stock was up 29-1/2p at 664, after yesterday setting its lowest close since February.

Market sources said Merrill Lynch reiterated a "buy" recommendation on the stock after the year-end review, despite downgrading its earnings forecasts by five million stg in 1997 and 1998 to 135 million and 155 million respectively.
Analyst Colin Isaac at Credit Lyonnias Laing also said he remained positive on Laporte shares.
"I think the reason it's up is a big sigh of relief after the trading statment -- it had been coming off for a while before that," Isaac said.
In its statement Laporte said trading was in line with expectations in the second half of 1996.

It added that while trading conditions remained competitive, the international spread of its businesses, together with the strong market and technology positions in specialist sectors, gave a base for solid progress in the year as a whole.
